description:
Department: NAM – Arc’teryx PRO

Reports to: Account Operations Supervisor

Location: North Vancouver, B.C.

 

Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As a temporary, Account Operations Representative for PRO, you play a key role in supporting commercial and operational objectives by enabling efficient business processes, maintaining operational excellence, and delivering a seamless customer experience. Working closely with Account Management, Business Development, and cross-functional teams, you help drive business performance through operational support, process optimization, and effective issue resolution. Leveraging data, systems, and continuous improvement initiatives, you contribute to scalable solutions that support growth and organizational success.

Please note, this is a temporary role until October 2027.

This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.

 

Meet Your Future Team:

The PRO team is a highly versatile sales and service team within the Commercial Department at Arc’teryx. We provide purpose-built solutions for professional end users and strategic partners who rely on our products to perform their craft at the highest level. The Account Operations team is focused on delivering professional, efficient, and proactive support to deliver and enhance our value proposition to our targeted consumers, strategic business partners, government organizations, and procurement officials.

We highly value teamwork, collaboration and supporting one another to deliver exceptional outcomes.

lists.text: If you were the Account Operations Representative - Temporary now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:
lists.content:
• Assisting the Account Operations Supervisor in executing strategic commercial service objectives and supporting key operational initiatives
  • Serving as the primary point of contact for inbound sales leads, managing inquiries and connecting prospects with appropriate channel partners
  • Overseeing day-to-day order management operations, such as ensuring timely order fulfillment and resolution of order, shipping, logistics, and return-related issues
  • Supporting the B2B Embellished Retail and Uniform Program by maintaining program tracking tools, coordinating embellishment requirements, and managing related Salesforce and SAP activities
  • Maintaining commercial reports, sales tools, and content across internal and customer-facing platforms, ensuring accurate and accessible information for stakeholders
  • Utilizing inventory and order reporting to monitor demand, track product movement, and identify inventory optimization opportunities
  • Facilitating customer and product data maintenance to ensure information accuracy across systems
  • Developing and maintaining process documentation, training materials, and workflow standards to improve operational efficiency and support internal teams

lists.text: Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:
lists.content:
• Driving process improvements and automation initiatives to increase operational efficiency and reduce manual effort
  • Enhancing reporting and analytics capabilities to provide actionable business insights and support data-driven decision-making
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize inventory management, demand planning, and customer service processes
  • Supporting system enhancements and technology implementations to improve operational effectiveness and scalability
  • Developing training resources, operational standards, and best practices to strengthen team capabilities and consistency
  • Contributing to strategic business initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve customer experience, support growth, and optimize commercial operations
  • Traveling as required to support the commercial and sales teams at tradeshows, customer visits, and to owned events

lists.text: Are you our next Account Operations Representative - Temporary?
lists.content:
• You have 2+ years of customer service, retail, or customer-facing experience
  • You have 1+ years of experience supporting B2B sales or business customers
  • You Demonstrate strong communication skills and can effectively collaborate with sales teams, customers, and cross-functional partners
  • You take a proactive, solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving and confidently own challenges through to resolution
  • You possess exceptional organizational skills, with a strong focus on accuracy and attention to detail
  • You are proficient with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
  • You have experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and ERP systems such as SAP
  • You adapt quickly to changing priorities and can effectively manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment
  • You are able to balance autonomy and collaboration
  • You inspire breakthrough thinking and continuous improvement
  • You seek the best (but sometimes not the easiest) solutions, with an unwavering commitment
  • Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it
The salary range for this role is: CAD$62,000 - CAD$81,000

descriptionPlain:
Department: Regional Supply Chain – NAM
Capability Area: Wholesale Planning & Account Services - NAM
Location: North Vancouver  

Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As a Account Services Coordinator – NAM (Temporary), you are at the center of how Arc'teryx products reach wholesale accounts, translating inventory availability into fulfillment decisions that protect service levels and support commercial relationships. You will build hands-on expertise in orderbook management across prebook, in-season, and replenishment cycles, developing a strong foundation in the trade-offs between supply constraints, account priorities, and inventory health. This role offers hands-on responsibility for a complex, high-volume orderbook and the opportunity to develop your analytical and cross-functional collaboration skills in a fast-paced, global supply chain environment. You will work closely with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Commercial teams, gaining broad visibility into how the business balances supply and demand at the regional level.
This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada

Meet Your Future Team:
The Wholesale Planning & Account Services - NAM team leads the regional wholesale channel planning cycle end to end, bringing together merchandise planning, demand planning, and inventory allocation to support wholesale partners and deliver on regional business priorities. The team works closely with Commercial, Global Inventory Planning, Global Merchandise Planning, and omni-channel planning teams to translate account needs, market insights, and inventory considerations into coordinated plans that support order management, replenishment, and in-season decisions. Together, the team helps ensure wholesale accounts receive the right product, in the right quantities, at the right time, while reflecting regional nuances and strengthening cross-functional alignment.

lists.text: If you were in the Account Services Coordinator – NAM (Temporary) role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:
lists.content:
• Executing against wholesale service level targets, including fulfillment rate, on-time delivery, and order fulfillment accuracy across accounts
  • Managing the wholesale orderbook across prebook, in-season, and replenishment orders, validating orders against available inventory and supply plans, and maintaining accurate order prioritization rules
  • Optimizing shipment timing and phasing to maximize fill rates while protecting inventory health and margin
  • Partnering with Wholesale Sales to manage account expectations, delivery windows, and orderbook changes
  • Translating demand and inventory plans into wholesale order fulfillment decisions, balancing competing priorities across accounts under supply constraints

lists.text: Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:
lists.content:
• Developing and refining orderbook management practices that improve fill rate consistency and reduce fulfillment exceptions across wholesale accounts
  • Building deeper cross-functional partnerships with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Commercial teams to strengthen how the region anticipates and responds to supply constraints

lists.text: Are you our next Account Services Coordinator - NAM?
lists.content:
• You have a bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related field
  • You have 2+ years of experience in Allocation, Wholesale Operations, or a similar supply chain role
  • You have a solid understanding of orderbook management, including prebook, in-season, and replenishment order types
  • You have a working understanding of fill rate and service level optimization, and how inventory constraints affect order fulfillment
  • You have experience managing large volumes of orders across multiple accounts with strong attention to detail
  • You have strong Excel and data analysis skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve fulfillment issues
  • You are a clear and effective communicator, able to translate supply constraint trade-offs for commercial and planning partners
  • You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners
The salary range for this role is: CAD$62,000 - CAD$81,000

descriptionPlain:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As a Finance Analyst of Arc’teryx Korea and a key partner to the Finance Manager, you will play a crucial role in maintaining data integrity and delivering actionable financial insights. You will support the day-to-day execution of budgeting, forecasting, and long-term strategic planning (LTSP) to drive informed business decisions.
Meet Your Future Team:
 
The Finance Team at Arc’teryx Korea is responsible for providing local and HQ leadership with the information they need to review past performance, understand business trends, and anticipate future profitability and financial position. Through rigorous accounting governance, historic financial reviews, variance analysis, and KPI tracking, the team advises leadership on key investment decisions and performance improvement while ensuring a robust internal control environment.
description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As a Finance Analyst of Arc’teryx Korea and a key partner to the Finance Manager, you will play a crucial role in maintaining data integrity and delivering actionable financial insights. You will support the day-to-day execution of budgeting, forecasting, and long-term strategic planning (LTSP) to drive informed business decisions.

Meet Your Future Team:

 

The Finance Team at Arc’teryx Korea is responsible for providing local and HQ leadership with the information they need to review past performance, understand business trends, and anticipate future profitability and financial position. Through rigorous accounting governance, historic financial reviews, variance analysis, and KPI tracking, the team advises leadership on key investment decisions and performance improvement while ensuring a robust internal control environment.

lists.content:
If you were the Finance Analyst, Finance Arc’teryx Korea, here are some of the core activities you would be:

1. Budgeting, Forecasting & Long-Term Planning

  • Data Collection & Validation: Act as the first finance contact for cross-functional departments to collect budget, forecast, and strategic plan inputs. Conduct rigorous 1st-stage verification and data validation to ensure alignment with financial guidelines before consolidation.

    •  

  • Consolidation Support: Assist the Finance Manager in constructing, consolidating, and updating monthly rolling forecasts, annual budgets, and long-term strategic plans.

    •  

  • Variance Tracking: Monitor and analyze day-to-day financial data and track variances (Budget vs. Actual) to identify trends, risks, and performance gaps.

    •  

  • Reporting Support: Prepare regular and ad-hoc financial performance packages, dashboards, and operational commentary for leadership team.

    •  

  • Cash Flow Modeling: Prepare, maintain, and update daily/monthly cash flow forecasts to optimize local liquidity and working capital.

    •  

    2. System Optimization

  • Standardize and optimize financial workflows during the system transition to ensure seamless business continuity.

    •  

    Are you our next Finance Analyst, Finance Arc’teryx Korea?

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related field. (AICPA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred).
  • You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in corporate finance and accounting (Experience in multinational corporate environments is an asset).
  • You have strong background in financial data review, accounting governance, and working with external professional service firms.
  • You have advanced financial modeling, forecasting, and Microsoft Excel skills (Experience with SAP, Oracle, and Power BI is an asset).
  • You have strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • You have business level English skill (written and verbal).
  • You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.
  • You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.
  • You can balance autonomy and collaboration.
  • You inspire breakthrough thinking and continuous improvement.
  • Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.
